items.headline: Mahomes is back — and the Chiefs roll on Monday night
items.body: Patrick Mahomes returned from offseason knee surgery looking just fine, even scampering in for a rushing touchdown as Kansas City handled Denver 31-10 to close out Week 1.
items.say: Did you catch Mahomes on Monday night? Comes back from knee surgery and he's already running it in for touchdowns.

items.headline: Clinch season is here — Yankees and Dodgers punch their tickets
items.body: The Yankees and Dodgers both locked up playoff spots this week, joining the Rays (who walked it off against Houston). Now the division races — Brewers closing out the NL Central, a tight Astros–Rangers scrap out West — heat up with two weeks to go.
items.say: Baseball's playoff picture is finally taking shape — Yankees and Dodgers are in. Your team still got a shot?

items.headline: Saturday's got juice — Oregon at USC headlines Week 4
items.body: After weeks of chaos and top-five upsets, Week 4 brings another loaded slate: No. 21 Oregon heads to No. 12 USC in a Big Ten heavyweight tilt, while Iowa visits Michigan. Clear the calendar.
items.say: You doing anything Saturday? Oregon–USC should be a good one — college football's been absolute chaos this year.

items.headline: F1 hits Baku — and it's a rare Saturday race
items.body: The Azerbaijan Grand Prix runs on the streets of Baku this year on Saturday, Sept. 26 — bumped a day early to avoid the country's day of remembrance. Those tight concrete walls always seem to deliver drama.
items.say: Odd one for F1 fans — the Baku race is on a Saturday this year. That street circuit is basically a demolition derby waiting to happen.

items.headline: A night to remember — 'Widow's Bay' cleans up, Michael J. Fox steals the show
items.body: Comedy 'Widow's Bay' set a record with 14 wins, Matthew Rhys made history with two lead-acting Emmys in one night, and 'The Pitt' took Best Drama. But the moment everyone's replaying: Michael J. Fox's standing ovation for the Bob Hope Humanitarian Award.
items.say: Did you see Michael J. Fox at the Emmys? Whole room on its feet — total goosebumps moment.

items.headline: South Park is back — Season 29 kicks off Wednesday
items.body: Trey Parker and Matt Stone return Wednesday night on Comedy Central (streaming the next day on Paramount+), with their satire reportedly aimed at AI and internet culture. And they're fresh off another Emmy win.
items.say: South Park's back Wednesday — 29 seasons in and still swinging. You still keep up with it?

items.headline: Prom night, reimagined — Mike Flanagan's 'Carrie' drops a chilling trailer
items.body: Horror favorite Mike Flanagan ('The Haunting of Hill House') is behind a new eight-episode take on Stephen King's 'Carrie,' hitting Prime Video Oct. 7. The just-released trailer is properly unsettling.
items.say: You a horror person? Mike Flanagan's doing a whole Carrie series — the trailer looks genuinely creepy.

items.headline: The Fugees reunite — Lauryn Hill and Wyclef headline Global Citizen
items.body: The Global Citizen Festival returns to Central Park on Sept. 26, and the big draw is Ms. Lauryn Hill & Wyclef Jean marking 30 years of the Fugees' classic 'The Score,' alongside Lenny Kravitz, John Legend and more.
items.say: The Fugees are reuniting for Global Citizen — 30 years of 'The Score.' 'Killing Me Softly' still hits, right?

items.headline: Stevie Wonder's taking 'Songs in the Key of Life' on tour
items.body: A true legend move: Stevie Wonder announced a short run of shows celebrating the 50th anniversary of his masterpiece 'Songs in the Key of Life,' with dates rolling out this November and December.
items.say: Stevie Wonder's touring 'Songs in the Key of Life' for its 50th. That album's got 'Sir Duke,' 'Isn't She Lovely' — just flawless.
